from fractions import Fraction as Q
from pathlib import Path
import json
checks=0
for nx,ny in [(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,4),(4,3)]:
 px=[Q(i+1,sum(range(1,nx+1))) for i in range(nx)]
 py=[Q(2*j+1,ny*ny) for j in range(ny)]
 assert sum(px)==sum(py)==1
 for seed in range(-20,21):
  f=[[Q((i+1)*(j+2)+seed*(i-j),3) for j in range(ny)] for i in range(nx)]
  source_mean=[sum(px[i]*f[i][j] for i in range(nx)) for j in range(ny)]
  clock_mean=[sum(py[j]*f[i][j] for j in range(ny)) for i in range(nx)]
  total=sum(px[i]*py[j]*f[i][j] for i in range(nx) for j in range(ny))
  assert sum(py[j]*source_mean[j] for j in range(ny))==total
  assert sum(px[i]*clock_mean[i] for i in range(nx))==total
  for i in range(nx):
   for j in range(ny):
    source_center=f[i][j]-source_mean[j]
    clock_center_after_source=source_mean[j]-total
    assert source_center+clock_center_after_source==f[i][j]-total
    checks+=1
v=dict(passed=True,weighted_product_centering_checks=checks,product_models=5,target_matrices=205,arithmetic='fractions.Fraction exact; nonuniform independent product weights; not a proof of predictability')
Path('.lake/stardust-1301-exact-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
print(v)
